question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Microsoft guided FQ1 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026) revenue to $89.85-90.95B (16-17% YoY), midpoint about $90.4B. Over the last 4 quarters Microsoft beat its guidance midpoint by about 1.5-3.5%: FQ1 FY26 77.7 vs ~75.25; FQ2 81.3 vs 80.05; FQ3 82.9 vs ~81.2; FQ4 90.0 vs 87.25. Applying the average beat of about 2.5% gives roughly $91.6B. Visible Alpha consensus is about $90.7B, but consensus has also been beaten by 1.8-2.7% recently. Risks: FX movement since late July, and Azure capacity limits making the beat smaller. A result below the guidance midpoint (<$90.2B) is rare, so I priced it at about 3%. Market check: no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi revenue market found; Kalshi only lists earnings-call 'mention' markets. The report is expected around Oct 28. A MarketBeat page showing an 'actual' EPS looked like a placeholder and was ignored.

- Prior-year comparison: FQ1 FY26 revenue $77.7B.
- FQ4 FY26 (Jun 2026): revenue $90.01B (+18%, +17% cc). Guidance was $86.7-87.8B; consensus was $87.61B. Azure grew 43%, and the CFO credited fleet efficiency and faster capacity delivery (CNBC/Microsoft, Jul 29 2026).
- FQ3 FY26 (Mar 2026): revenue $82.9B (+18%, +15% cc, so FX added about 3 points) vs consensus $81.39B. Guidance given that quarter was seen as light (Microsoft/SiliconANGLE, Apr 29 2026).
- FQ2 FY26: guidance $79.5-80.6B, actual $81.3B. FQ1 FY26: guidance midpoint about $75.25B, actual $77.7B.
- Beat vs guidance midpoint over the last 4 quarters: about +3.2%, +1.5%, +2%, +3.2%.
- Visible Alpha consensus for FQ1 FY27 is about $90.7B, near the top of guidance (TIKR, Oct 5 2026).
- The stock is up about 39% since Jun 30 (TIKR).
- Report expected around Oct 27-28, 2026; the prior-year report was Oct 29.
- Status quo: Microsoft reports above its guidance midpoint; it has not reported below the midpoint in the last 4 quarters.
- Downside risks: a stronger dollar during Jul-Sep 2026 (not checked); Azure capacity constraints; segment reorganization (total revenue unaffected).
- Resolves off total revenue in Microsoft's FQ1 FY27 earnings release (not segment figures).
- Event window: next revenue report after Sep 2026, expected about Oct 28. As of Oct 7, the quarter is closed and awaiting the report.
- Searched but not found: FX moves in Jul-Sep 2026; any Kalshi or Polymarket revenue market (only earnings-call word markets exist).

calls.reasoning: Guidance for FQ1 FY27 is $89.85-90.95B (midpoint $90.4B); consensus is about $90.6-90.7B. Over the last four quarters Microsoft beat its guidance midpoint by 1.6-3.2% (mean ~2.3%), which implies ~$92.4B. I shaded to ~$92.1B because the dollar strengthened in late September after guidance was set at July rates, and because Q4's 3.2% beat looks unusually large. The Azure guide of 44-45% cc supports a beat. Tails: below $90.2B would require a sub-midpoint print, which has not happened in recent quarters; above $94.5B would require a beat of more than 4.5%. Market check: no Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmaker market on MSFT revenue found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on guidance, history and consensus; their medians ranged from $91.6B to $92.6B. The gap came from (a) whether to anchor on the beat vs guidance or the beat vs consensus, and how much FX to subtract (judgment), and (b) Run 3 citing old-structure segment guides (IC/PBP) while Runs 1-2 cited Agents & Infra / Devices & Consumer (factual). My search confirmed the $89.85-90.95B total guide, the new two-segment structure (A&I $75.15-75.75B, D&C $14.7-15.2B) and Azure guidance of 44-45% cc. Run 3's segment figures don't affect total revenue. A second search confirmed the report date of Oct 27/28 and found one consensus figure of $90.59B. I did not search FX directly; I rely on Run 2's finding that the dollar index rose from 98.6 to 101 in September, a mild headwind of about 0.3-0.5%. Run 1's $91.6B looks too low: it is barely 1.3% over the midpoint, below every one of the last four beats. Run 3's $92.6B gives FX no weight. I land at $92.1B.
